title: 2026 U.S. House of Representatives Election in California's 9th Congressional District
jurisdiction: California's 9th Congressional District — San Joaquin County (Stockton, Tracy, Manteca, Lodi) and parts of Contra Costa and Stanislaus counties
description: California's 9th Congressional District is holding a general election on November 3, 2026, following a top-two primary on June 2, 2026. Incumbent Democrat Josh Harder, first elected in 2018, advanced to the general election alongside Republican challenger John McBride, a strength and conditioning coach. The district, which leans Democratic (Cook PVI D+8) and covers Stockton, Tracy, and parts of the East Bay, has been rated 'Solid Democratic' by the Cook Political Report. Key issues in the race include water access for agriculture, public safety, housing affordability, health care costs, and infrastructure investment.
polling_note: No independent public opinion polls specific to the CA-09 general election were found as of mid-2026. The Cook Political Report rates the race as 'Solid Democratic.' A national NRCC battleground survey from August 2025 included CA-09 but did not release head-to-head numbers.

candidates.name: Josh Harder
candidates.summary: Josh Harder is the incumbent Democratic U.S. Representative for California's 9th Congressional District, first elected in 2018. He serves on the powerful House Appropriations Committee and has focused on health care, lowering costs, water infrastructure, and public safety during his tenure. Harder is a fifth-generation Central Valley resident who previously worked as a venture capitalist and taught business at Modesto Junior College.

candidates.name: John McBride
candidates.summary: John McBride is a Republican candidate for the U.S. House in California's 9th Congressional District. A strength and conditioning coach by profession, he served as the first Strength and Conditioning Coach at the University of the Pacific for 12 years and later at St. Mary's High School for 13 years. McBride emphasizes his community involvement, including board service with the Stockton Leadership Foundation and local Christian organizations, and campaigns on issues of fiscal responsibility, border security, agriculture, and reducing government regulation.
